Shared includes referenced by AYN/Odin2 UCM (normally from distro alsa-ucm-conf):

  /usr/share/alsa/ucm2/lib/card-init.conf
  /usr/share/alsa/ucm2/lib/ctl-remap.conf
  /usr/share/alsa/ucm2/codecs/wcd938x/*
  /usr/share/alsa/ucm2/codecs/qcom-lpass/rx-macro/*
  /usr/share/alsa/ucm2/codecs/qcom-lpass/tx-macro/*

If the image's alsa-ucm-conf is too old, copy from vendor/audio/ucm2-shared-reference/.

Reference file names observed on a working SM8550 desktop stack:

card-init.conf
ctl-remap.conf

wcd938x/:
  AnalogMic1DisableSeq.conf AnalogMic1EnableSeq.conf
  AnalogMic5DisableSeq.conf AnalogMic5EnableSeq.conf
  HeadphoneABEnableSeq.conf HeadphoneDisableSeq.conf HeadphoneEnableSeq.conf
  HeadphoneMicDisableSeq.conf HeadphoneMicEnableSeq.conf init.conf

qcom-lpass/rx-macro/:
  HeadphoneDisableSeq.conf HeadphoneEnableSeq.conf
  HeadphoneLDisableSeq.conf HeadphoneLEnableSeq.conf init.conf

qcom-lpass/tx-macro/:
  DMIC0DisableSeq.conf DMIC0EnableSeq.conf
  HeadphoneMicDisableSeq.conf HeadphoneMicEnableSeq.conf
  SoundwireMic0EnableSeq.conf SoundwireMic1EnableSeq.conf
  SoundwireMicDisableSeq.conf
